channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Austin Ainge | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Austin Ainge from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ryan Smith on Austin Ainge
item.description:
“We are trying to win a championship. So everything should be on the table. Austin and Danny (Ainge) have also been known to do some pretty crazy stuff on draft night.”

Ryan Smith on Austin Ainge, May 14, 2026. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Ryan Smith on Austin Ainge
item.description:
Smith, on why Austin Ainge was the guy:

“Really it came to a conversation with me and Ashley and some of the folks in our group — who would you go get? What would you do? And I kept coming back to Austin. The challenge was, I had no clue how Austin felt.”

Ryan Smith on Austin Ainge, Jun 2, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Will Hardy on Austin Ainge
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Will Hardy quote on Austin Ainge:

“During my time with the Celtics, I really enjoyed working alongside Austin and was able to gain a great appreciation of his basketball insight and acumen. Having Austin to help guide our group as we continue to grow is huge for our program.”

Will Hardy on Austin Ainge, Jun 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Austin Ainge
item.description:
Danny Ainge:

“It has been taxing. I have a great staff of people. It’s just an opportunity to let them do more and have a say. Brad and Mike and Austin have been there a long time; just giving them a chance. I’m anxious to see how it all works out.”

Danny Ainge on Austin Ainge, Aug 9, 2021. Source: asherrodblakely.com.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Mike Zarren, Austin Ainge
item.description:
Brad Stevens:

“Whatever they asked me to do, I would have done it. This side is a great opportunity. I'm invigorated by it. I'm excited. We're set up great. Mike Zarren, Austin Ainge, they are going to make this transition easy. I'm looking forward to working with them.”

Brad Stevens on Mike Zarren, Austin Ainge, Jun 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @GoodmanHoops.
